The Governor describe these distinguished recognitions as a fitting tribute to an extraordinary life of service, excellence, integrity, intellectual accomplishment and unwavering commitment to national development.
The three prestigious honours are: ASUU HEROES AWARD , conferred on him on Thursday, 12th November, 2026 , DOCTOR OF PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION (HONORIS CAUSA) by Nile University, Abuja, conferred on him today Thursday, 19th November, 2026 , and HONORARY DOCTORATE DEGREE by Michael Okpara University of Agriculture, Umudike, to be conferred on him on Saturday, 28th November, 2026.
Governor Mohammed notes that these recognitions transcend the conferment of honorary titles and awards; they represent a profound institutional appreciation of a lifetime dedicated to public service, educational advancement, nation-building, institutional development and the promotion of national unity.
He observe that Alhaji Mahmud Yayale Ahmed’s distinguished career in the Nigerian public service, culminating in his meritorious service as Secretary to the Government of the Federation, stands as an enduring example of professionalism, administrative excellence, humility, patriotism and selfless dedication to the Nigerian project.
According to the Governor, this remarkable contributions to public administration, governance and national development have continued to inspire generations of public servants and leaders, earning him admiration and respect across political, professional, academic and traditional institutions.
“ I particularly consider the recognition by the Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU), Nile University, Abuja, and Michael Okpara University of Agriculture, Umudike, as a powerful affirmation of the breadth, depth and enduring significance of his contributions to the advancement of society “ the Governor said .
He further states that Bauchi State is immensely proud of Alhaji Mahmud Yayale Ahmed, whose exemplary career, distinguished accomplishments and outstanding national service have continued to bring honour, prestige and positive recognition to the state.
The Governor emphasises that such distinguished recognition of a son of Bauchi State is not only a moment of personal celebration for the award recipient and his family but also a source of collective pride for the entire state and an inspiration to younger generations to embrace the virtues of hard work, integrity, discipline, knowledge and service to humanity.
While congratulating the revered elder statesman on these well-deserved honours, Governor Mohammed pray that the Almighty Allah will grant him continued good health, renewed strength, abundant wisdom and many more fruitful years of impactful service to the nation and humanity .
